# 雪迹 PowderClub — 全量目录清单 / Complete Catalog Reference (llms-full.txt)

> 精简索引 / Concise Index: https://huling1215.github.io/llms.txt
> 多语言站点地图 / Sitemap Index: https://huling1215.github.io/sitemap-index.xml

## 1. 品牌与核验原则 / Brand & Verification Policy
- **定位**：雪迹（PowderClub）收录全球主要雪场参数、滑进滑出酒店、分级住滑套餐与实测问答攻略。
- **原则**：不编造评分，不做跨语言静默回退，所有价格基准为 CNY 人民币。

## 2. 全部滑雪场 / All Ski Resorts (43)
- **北大湖滑雪度假区 / Beidahu Ski Resort** (`china/jilin` · Top 1405m / Drop 870m / 64 runs)
  - URLs: zh-CN: https://huling1215.github.io/resorts/china/jilin/beidahu/ | en: https://huling1215.github.io/en/resorts/china/jilin/beidahu/
  - 摘要 (zh-CN): 位于吉林省永吉县五里河镇，山体落差870米，开放64条雪道与11条缆车。冬季静风率高、粉雪干爽稳定，山脚汇集多栋滑进滑出酒店与儿童托管营地。
  - Summary (en): Set in Yongji County, Jilin with an 870 m vertical drop across 64 runs and 11 lifts. Calm winter winds preserve dry snow, paired with base-area ski-in/ski-out hotels and a dedicated kids camp.
- **瓦纳卡卡德罗纳高山度假村 / Cardrona Alpine Resort** (`new-zealand/otago` · Top 1860m / Drop 600m / 45 runs)
  - URLs: zh-CN: https://huling1215.github.io/resorts/new-zealand/otago/cardrona-wanaka/ | en: https://huling1215.github.io/en/resorts/new-zealand/otago/cardrona-wanaka/
  - 摘要 (zh-CN): 坐落于新西兰南岛瓦纳卡与皇后镇之间，每年6至10月开启南半球反季雪季。山顶海拔1860米、落差600米，涵盖开阔高山碗区、Soho扩建雪域与地形公园。
  - Summary (en): Set between Wānaka and Queenstown for Southern Hemisphere winter skiing from June to October, pairing an 1,860 m summit and 600 m vertical drop with wide alpine basins, Soho Basin terrain, and progressive parks.

  - URLs: zh-CN: https://huling1215.github.io/resorts/china/jilin/changbaishan-wanda/ | en: https://huling1215.github.io/en/resorts/china/jilin/changbaishan-wanda/
  - 摘要 (zh-CN): 位于吉林省白山市抚松县北纬41度三面环山谷地，山顶海拔1210米，落差395米，开放43条雪道与7条索道，汇集滑进滑出酒店群与火山矿物质温泉。
  - Summary (en): Sheltered in a three-sided valley at 41°N in Fusong County, Jilin, reaching 1,210 m with a 395 m vertical drop across 43 runs and 7 lifts, paired with ski-in/ski-out hotels and volcanic hot springs.

  - Summary (en): Set on the north face of 2,160 m Mt. Yushiliang in Chongli, Hebei with a 510 m vertical drop, 31 runs, and 6 high-speed lifts—just 3 km and a 10-minute complimentary shuttle from Taizicheng HSR Station.

  - 摘要 (zh-CN): 串联高雪维尔、梅里贝尔与葱仁谷等雪区，形成总长约600公里的无缝滑行雪道网，缆车高点达3230米。阶梯式分布海拔1100至1850米多个住滑村落。
  - Summary (en): Uniting Courchevel, Méribel, and Val Thorens across 600 km of ski-linked pistes reaching 3,230 m, anchored by stepped ski-in/ski-out villages spanning 1,100 m to 1,850 m in Savoie.

  - Summary (en): Located in Hemu Township, Burqin County, Altay, descending from 2,848 m Yunxiao Peak to a 1,382 m base for a 1,466 m vertical drop across 103 trails and 8 high-speed lifts with dry alpine powder.

  - Summary (en): Positioned in Shimukappu's cold inland powder belt with a 1,239 m peak, 699 m vertical drop, and 29 runs. Pairs dry snow with the Terrace of Frost Tree, Ice Village, Mina-Mina wave pool, and direct JR Limited Express rail access.

  - Summary (en): Linking Grand Hirafu, Hanazono, Niseko Village, and Annupuri across one peak with a 940 m vertical drop. Sea of Japan storms deliver frequent dry powder alongside expansive night skiing and onsen lodges.

  - 直接答案: 拼周五请1至2天假选韩国龙平或High1更省时（飞首尔约2小时，4天人均5500元起）；看重天然雪与温泉选日本苗场（7500元起）。
- **冬季去新疆阿勒泰禾木吉克普林滑雪，山路冰雪怎么安排四驱雪地胎交通与供暖住宿？ / How Should You Arrange 4WD Snow-Tire Transport and Heated Lodging for Winter Skiing in Hemu Jikepulin?** (Published: 2026-11-19)

  - 直接答案: 零基础与家庭练活选拥有1200米宽缓坡的栂池高原；初中级混滑与地形公园进阶选双山相连的五龙47；挑战1071米大落差陡坡选八方尾根。

- **带孩子去滑进滑出雪场需要准备哪些装备与托管手续？ / What Gear and Kids Club Prep Do Families Need for a Ski-In/Ski-Out Trip?** (Published: 2026-11-14)

- **初次住滑去吉林北大湖还是北海道二世谷？ / Beidahu vs. Niseko: Where Should You Book Your First Ski-and-Stay Trip?** (Published: 2026-11-12)
  - URLs: zh-CN: https://huling1215.github.io/guides/how-to-choose-first-ski-resort-china-japan/ | en: https://huling1215.github.io/en/guides/how-to-choose-first-ski-resort-china-japan/
  - 直接答案: 假期在4至5天、侧重高密度中文教学与控制总预算时选吉林北大湖；假期在6天以上、已能滑行蓝道且看重天然粉雪与温泉小镇氛围时选北海道二世谷。
